name: Little Eyes What You See
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of guarding our eyes and hearts to maintain purity and wisdom. Job declares a covenant with his eyes to avoid lustful thoughts, while the psalmist commits to not setting wicked things before his eyes, demonstrating a resolve to walk with a perfect heart. Proverbs reinforces this by highlighting that God has given both the hearing ear and seeing eye, underscoring their divine purpose, and warns against an 'evil eye' that hastens after riches without regard for consequences. Together, these verses teach that what we choose to see shapes the moral and spiritual course of our lives.
